zones.name: The Study
zones.notes: Murder site. Braun only. Reachable only via entry and family_room. Exterior windows face the lawn.
zones.clue_spot: The scene itself. The bloody QR.

zones.name: Entry
zones.clue_spot: The console table by the study corridor.

zones.name: Kitchen
zones.clue_spot: The service counter, among the delivery paperwork.

zones.name: Sitting Room & Stairs

zones.name: Grand Hall
zones.clue_spot: The stage area and the champagne tower wreckage.

zones.name: Grand Hall Extension
zones.clue_spot: The bar crates and the storage door.

zones.name: Driveway
zones.clue_spot: Around the parked cars and the side path.
zones.notes: The side path wraps to the study side of the house. Access via side_path route.

zones.name: The Lawn & Gardens
zones.clue_spot: The far garden bed and beneath the study windows.
zones.notes: The study's exterior windows face the lawn. Access via window route.
